name: blueprint/media-fetch
description: Keyless media search and storage: Wikimedia Commons API supplies images without a key, R2 stores the binaries, the store indexes them, presigned links share them
ingredients: guardedFetch over the Wikimedia Commons API (keyless)
recipe: search Commons for the media -> fetch the file bytes -> put to R2 and index in the store -> share via a presigned link
pitfalls: Commons is keyless but rate-limited - probe and cache
media is binary - files_put needs the right contentType
the presigned URL is a secret for its window
respect the source license - the index records attribution
